capabilities: Render paragraph block embeds inline within sentences in Live Preview and Reading view
Show a hover preview of the source block and open it with Ctrl/Cmd-click
Display missing blocks as unresolved-link text using the alias or link text
Resolve nested inline embeds up to three levels deep and stop at loops
Keep inline rendering through PDF export via the Markdown post processor
disambiguation: Not a CSS restyling of embed boxes; it reads blocks through the public API and draws real inline text in the line.
extras: Freemium: paragraph blocks inline are free; list items, all-embeds-inline, and extra styles need Pro via GitHub Sponsors sign-in (device flow, read:user scope only, no vault data sent). After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later.
intentEvidence: Without the plugin, Obsidian draws a block embed as a box with a frame, even in the middle of a sentence.
problem: Obsidian draws a block embed as a framed box on its own line, splitting a sentence in two even when the embed sits mid-sentence.

relations.evidence: Rest the pointer on the inline text to see the source block in the core page preview.
The snippets restyle the box and broke after Obsidian updates. This plugin reads the block with the public API

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($15 once or $5/month) for Pro features

summary: Renders block embeds written inside a sentence as inline text with a dotted underline, hover preview, and Ctrl/Cmd-click jump to the source block.
